scripts.dev:sandbox: docker compose up -d --build && npm run dev:web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @abseed/spectra-core && npm run test -w @abseed/spectra-agent-tools && npm run test -w @abseed/spectra-drift-check && npm run test -w @abseed/spectra-server && npm run test -w @abseed/spectra-web-lib && npm run test -w @abseed/spectra-web && npm run test -w @abseed/spectra-cli
scripts.test:integration:docker: docker build -f test/integration/Dockerfile -t spectra-integration . && docker run --rm spectra-integration
scripts.test:install:docker: docker build -f test/integration/Dockerfile.install -t spectra-install . && docker run --rm spectra-install
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/agent-tools && tsc -p packages/drift-check && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web-lib && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p packages/cli
